title: Component
description: One upstream for one capability, at components/<capability>/<upstream>.yaml. A cluster administrator installs it.

summary.description: What it gives the cluster, in one plain sentence for people choosing components.

locales.description: The summary in other languages, by BCP 47 tag. config/locales.yaml lists the tags each needs.

license.description: SPDX expression; every identifier must be OSI-approved, or listed under optInOnly in config/licenses.yaml with no profile recommending the component.

defaults.description: Per profile: recommended (on by default), optional (off by default) or unsupported.

distributions.description: Distributions it runs on and e2e tests it on, of k3s, rke2 and kubesolo. kind tests it regardless. A reader ignores a value it does not know. The distributions where its test passed are a separate list, testedOn in index.json.

kubeVersion.description: The Kubernetes versions it supports, as a SemVer range like Helm's Chart.yaml kubeVersion: the strictest kubeVersion of its charts, else the oldest version that config/kubernetes.yaml renders. Every version that config/kubernetes.yaml renders or tests on must be in it.

persistsData.description: Keeps state in volumes; uninstalling loses data.

replaces.description: Component ids this one took over, which no component has now. An installer treats an install record with an old id as having this component.

inputs.description: Values the installer asks for or generates.

release.description: Release whose values receive the input; defaults to the first chart release.

path.description: Dotted values path; numbers index lists.

secret.description: Store the input in this Secret, created before install.

provides.description: What it offers other software in the cluster, beyond its capability.

registry.description: An OCI registry in the cluster that nodes pull from.

ca.description: The CA that signs its serving certificate.

internalCRDs.description: CRDs of detection.crds whose objects the component writes itself, so they don't mean anyone uses it.

work.description: Each kind of work the component does, such as a build. Names are unique.

requests.description: Resource requests of each pod doing one unit of work, for pods that no render shows, such as a build pod.

limits.description: Resource limits of each pod doing one unit of work.

use.description: What one unit of work uses on top of the component's idle use.

networkPolicies.description: Standard NetworkPolicy objects in its namespaces, for installers that block incoming traffic to each namespace by default: applied before the releases, they admit the traffic the component needs from elsewhere.

contributes.description: Values this component adds to another component's release.

target.description: The release of another component that receives the values.

detection.description: How to recognise an existing installation.

csiDrivers.description: CSI drivers of the PersistentVolumes it provides.

addons.description: Add-ons of a distribution that install the same upstream, such as k3s's packaged Traefik.

distribution.description: A reader ignores an entry of a distribution it does not know.

summary.description: What its RBAC lets it do.

podSecurity.description: The Pod Security Standard level its namespaces need.

health.description: Read-only checks that a tool such as zeabur-installer doctor runs on an installed cluster. Each is one `kubectl wait` and applies nothing. e2e runs them after install, before smoke.

wait.description: `kubectl wait` arguments, one per item, with a --for condition and without --timeout.

advice.description: What to do when the check fails, in English. An installer shows it to the reader.

smoke.description: Extra e2e checks after install. They may apply objects in catalog-smoke, so only e2e runs them. Read-only checks go in health.

manifest.description: Objects to apply first, in namespace catalog-smoke.

leftovers.description: What the upstream keeps on uninstall: a kind (customresourcedefinitions) or <resource>/<name>.

locale.description: A BCP 47 tag: language, then optional script and region, such as zh-TW or zh-Hant-TW.

generate.description: How the installer makes the value instead of asking. A reader does not fill in an input whose type it does not know.

type.description: random: bytes random bytes in encoding. clusterIP: a free address in the cluster's Service CIDR, for a Service's fixed ClusterIP.

quantities.description: Kubernetes quantities by resource name, such as memory: 256Mi. Each is above zero.

ref.description: A component by id, or a capability: its recommended upstream on the profile, else an optional one.

values.description: Helm values (YAML). Every value needs a comment saying why.

type.description: helm: a chart. manifest: files downloaded from urls. inline: the objects in manifests.

releaseName.description: Helm release name; defaults to name.

skipIfPresent.description: Skip when these CRDs already exist.

chart.description: oci://registry/path/chart, or a chart name with repo.

chartDigest.description: The chart at version: for an oci:// chart, its OCI manifest digest; for a chart in an HTTP repository, the SHA-256 of the chart archive, as the repository's index.yaml records it.

urlDigests.description: The SHA-256 of each file in urls, in the same order.

unpinnedImages.description: Images, without tag, that the chart cannot pin by digest. A comment says why.

profiles.description: Per-profile values merged over values (maps merge, lists replace).
